extra_vocab.en: a person whose job is to fix broken things
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇裡指來大樓修東西的外部維修人員。repairperson 不分性別，是 repairman 的中性說法，在商務英文很常見。

example.en: Both repairpersons must wear badges while they work in the building.
example.zh: 兩位維修人員在大樓裡工作時都必須配戴識別證。

example.en: The repairpeople will arrive at nine to check the elevators.
example.zh: 維修人員九點會到，檢查電梯。

example.en: Please call a repairperson if the air conditioner breaks again.
example.zh: 如果冷氣再壞掉，請叫維修人員來。

example.en: The company hired a repairperson to fix the broken door lock.
example.zh: 公司僱了一位維修人員來修壞掉的門鎖。

example.en: Only a qualified repairperson should open the electrical panel.
example.zh: 只有合格的維修人員才可以打開電箱。

examples.en: The repairperson signed in at the front desk and received a visitor badge.
examples.zh: 維修人員在櫃檯登記，並領取了訪客識別證。

examples.en: We called a repairperson because the printer on the third floor stopped working.
examples.zh: 三樓的印表機壞了，所以我們叫了維修人員。

examples.en: Please let the security desk know when the repairperson arrives tomorrow morning.
examples.zh: 維修人員明天早上到達時，請通知保全櫃檯。

confusable.diff: 意思相同，但 repairman 字面上指男性；現在職場文件多改用中性的 repairperson。

example.en: Our old sign said repairman, so we changed it to repairperson.
example.zh: 我們的舊告示寫 repairman，所以我們改成了 repairperson。

example.en: A technician will install the new security cameras on Friday.
example.zh: 技術人員星期五會來安裝新的監視器。

example.en: The mechanic checked the delivery van before it left the garage.
example.zh: 技工在送貨車離開車庫前檢查了這輛車。

example.en: The contractor finished the office repairs two days ahead of schedule.
example.zh: 承包商比預定時間提早兩天完成辦公室修繕。

derived.link: 最基礎的字。repairperson = repair（修理）+ person（人），修理的人，像 salesperson

extra_vocab.en: a room in a public building where people can wash their hands and use the toilet
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇裡是美式英文的禮貌說法，指公司或公共場所的洗手間。商務場合通常用 restroom，比 toilet 更得體。

example.en: The restrooms on the second floor are closed for cleaning today.
example.zh: 二樓的洗手間今天關閉清潔。

example.en: The mall has a public restroom on every floor.
example.zh: 這間購物中心每一層都有公共洗手間。

example.en: We will take a short restroom break after the first session.
example.zh: 第一場結束後，我們會休息一下讓大家上洗手間。

example.en: May I use the restroom before we start the interview?
example.zh: 面試開始前，我可以先去洗手間嗎？

examples.en: The restroom is down the hall, next to the elevator.
examples.zh: 洗手間在走廊盡頭，電梯旁邊。

examples.en: Customers may use the restroom on the first floor.
examples.zh: 顧客可以使用一樓的洗手間。

examples.en: Please keep the restroom clean for the next person.
examples.zh: 請保持洗手間整潔，方便下一位使用者。

confusable.diff: bathroom 本來指家裡有浴缸或淋浴的浴室，美式口語也常指廁所；restroom 是公共場所、辦公室的說法。

example.en: Our apartment has two bathrooms, but the office has only one restroom.
example.zh: 我們的公寓有兩間浴室，但辦公室只有一間洗手間。

confusable.diff: toilet 指馬桶本身（英式也指廁所），說法較直接；在美式商務場合問路時用 restroom 比較禮貌。

example.en: The toilet in the second-floor restroom needs repair this week.
example.zh: 二樓洗手間的馬桶這星期需要修理。

example.en: Please wait in the lobby until your host arrives.
example.zh: 請在大廳等候，直到接待你的人到來。

example.en: The restroom is at the end of the hallway.
example.zh: 洗手間在走廊的盡頭。

example.en: Lunch is in the break room on the fourth floor.
example.zh: 午餐在四樓的員工休息室。

extra_vocab.note: 在這篇裡修飾 alerts，說明按鈕不會發出警報聲，只會悄悄通知保全，所以不會驚動不守規定的訪客。

example.en: The new printer works silently, so it will not disturb anyone.
example.zh: 這台新印表機運作時沒有聲音，不會打擾任何人。

example.en: Please wait silently outside the room until your name is called.
example.zh: 請在房間外安靜等候，直到叫到你的名字。

example.en: The staff watched silently as the director announced the news.
example.zh: 主任宣布消息時，員工們默默地看著。

examples.en: The guard silently pressed the alarm button under the desk.
examples.zh: 警衛悄悄按下了桌子底下的警報按鈕。

examples.en: Participants waited silently while the manager read the report.
examples.zh: 經理讀報告時，與會者安靜地等著。

examples.en: She silently reviewed the contract before signing it.
examples.zh: 她簽約前默默地檢查了合約。

confusable.diff: silently 是完全沒有聲音；quietly 是聲音很小、很輕，但不一定完全無聲。

example.en: Please speak quietly in the meeting room so others can work.
example.zh: 請在會議室輕聲說話，讓其他人能工作。

similar.diff: 意思相同，較口語、較有畫面感；silently 一個字就能表達，比較簡潔正式。

example.en: He left the meeting without a sound to avoid disturbing others.
example.zh: 他不出聲地離開會議，以免打擾別人。

example.en: The company secretly tested the new product in two cities.
example.zh: 公司在兩個城市祕密測試了這項新產品。

example.en: The system automatically sends an alert when someone enters.
example.zh: 有人進入時，系統會自動發出通知。

derived.link: 最基礎的字。silent + -ly，形容詞變副詞，像 quick → quickly
silent 的 -t 換成 -ce，變成名詞，像 present → presence

extra_vocab.en: a person who goes with someone to guide or protect them
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇裡是名詞，指全程陪著訪客的人員，讓訪客不會自己亂走。have an escort 表示「有人陪同」。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: escort 當名詞時重音在前 /ˈeskɔːrt/，當動詞時重音在後 /ɪˈskɔːrt/。動詞用法是 escort + 人 + to + 地點。

example.en: Two escorts waited at the entrance to guide the visitors.
example.zh: 兩位陪同人員在入口等著帶領訪客。

example.en: Mr. Park escorts every guest to the elevator after the tour.
example.zh: 參觀結束後，帕克先生會陪每位客人到電梯。

example.en: The guard escorted the repairperson out of the building at six.
example.zh: 警衛六點把維修人員送出大樓。

example.en: She is escorting the inspectors through the warehouse right now.
example.zh: 她現在正陪著檢查人員走過倉庫。

example.en: Please provide an escort for every guest in the lab.
example.zh: 請為實驗室裡的每位訪客安排陪同人員。

example.en: The visitors were allowed to enter the factory only under escort.
example.zh: 訪客只有在有人陪同的情況下才能進入工廠。

example.en: Please escort Mr. Lee to the conference room on the fifth floor.
example.zh: 請陪李先生到五樓的會議室。

example.en: We arranged a security escort for the cash delivery tomorrow.
example.zh: 我們為明天的現金運送安排了保全護送。

examples.en: The receptionist asked for an escort to take the vendor upstairs.
examples.zh: 櫃檯人員請人陪廠商上樓。

examples.en: Staff members must provide an escort for all outside visitors.
examples.zh: 員工必須為所有外部訪客安排陪同人員。

examples.en: A driver will escort you from the airport to the hotel.
examples.zh: 司機會陪你從機場到飯店。

similar.diff: accompany 只是「陪著去」，語氣一般；escort 帶有引導、看管或保護的意味，常用在保全情境。

example.en: I will accompany the clients to the factory this afternoon.
example.zh: 我今天下午會陪客戶去工廠。

similar.diff: guide 重點在帶路、介紹；escort 重點在陪同並確保對方安全或不亂走。

example.en: A staff member will guide the visitors through the new office.
example.zh: 一位員工會帶訪客參觀新辦公室。

example.en: The guard checks every badge at the main entrance.
example.zh: 警衛會在大門口檢查每一張識別證。

example.en: Please wear your badge at all times inside the building.
example.zh: 在大樓內請隨時配戴識別證。

example.en: Every visitor must sign in at the front desk.
example.zh: 每位訪客都必須在櫃檯登記。

example.en: Each visitor needs an escort when walking through the secure area.
example.zh: 每位訪客在管制區走動時都需要有人陪同。

example.en: A guard will escort the guests to the meeting room.
example.zh: 警衛會陪客人到會議室。

senses.en: a person who goes with a visitor to guide or watch them

example.en: Visitors without an escort cannot enter the second floor.
example.zh: 沒有人陪同的訪客不能進入二樓。

senses.en: a group of people or cars that protect an important person
senses.distinguish: 從句子裡出現 police、CEO、convoy 等字，可看出是指一群人或車輛的護衛隊，不是單一陪同的人。

example.en: The CEO arrived at the airport with a police escort.
example.zh: 執行長在警察護衛隊的陪同下抵達機場。
